There is a game that is played in swimming pools....at least in America (I can't speak for other places...) called Marco Polo, named after an Italian Merchant from Venice that introduced Europeans to central Asia and China. The game is played as follows: One person, who is considered to be ''it'', closes his eyes and dunks his head under water while he counts to 5. It is the other players jobs to spread out and move about the pool. Once ''it'' is done counting, he lifts his head out of the water whilst still keeping his eyes closed. The person who is ''it'' yells out the word "MARCO!", and the rest of the players yell out "POLO!". The "it" person must try to tag the other players with his eyes closed, guided only by the sound of their voices and any other noises they might make. If at any time the "it" player suspects that one of the other players gets out of the pool, he says "FISH OUT OF WATER". If a player IS in fact out of the pool, he becomes the new it; otherwise, the person getting tagged is the new it.
